card.title: Envious Admiration
card.instruction: Be sincerely impressed by another player while trying not to appear lesser. Compliment, imitate, and compete at the same time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You make public speaking look effortless. I practised your shrug all night.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. My version of your shrug has more range.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That sounds so confident. I'm using that too.
